news.title: U.S. Energy Secretary Wright says Iran nuclear deal may never happen
news.description: Iran warned of faster, heavier retaliation against U.S. attacks while acknowledging the war’s mounting toll on its economy.

news.title: AI data centers are transforming rural land markets — and fueling a backlash
news.description: The data center buildout is driving up the price of rural land as some farmers and property owners buy in and others push back against development.

news.title: SEC sues ISS as Trump administration ramps up scrutiny of proxy advisers
news.description: The SEC sued Institutional Shareholder Services to enforce a subpoena as the Trump administration increases scrutiny of influential proxy advisers.
